answer: Because the raven stake is held until the lotus settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the orchard audit lists each exposure. A farm running 81 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. An attester must stake 14% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
